purpose: Measure whether Tool Schema v2 supports basic coding success and separate a practical local-small-model ceiling from a shared Harness failure.

runtime_source.fingerprint_method: sha256 of newline-joined ordered SHA-256 values below
runtime_source.invalidation_reason: Provider configuration isolation was implemented after the v1 freeze; those local runs are retained only as preflight evidence.

common_protocol.provider_config_isolation: Each arm uses an explicit --api-config-root; the task workspace remains unchanged.

preflight: Validate both task manifests before any model call.
Probe the pinned OCI image and effective non-root user.
Require the Qwen OpenAI tool probe and DeepSeek Anthropic tool probe to pass before their respective arm.

stopping_rules.interface_failure: Stop an arm if its first two Core tasks produce zero structured model-requested tool calls in total or any provider authentication/protocol failure.
stopping_rules.safety_failure: Stop immediately on hidden-test leakage, permission violation, or a changed path outside the task-derived allowlist.
stopping_rules.otherwise: Run all ten ordered tasks exactly once per arm. Do not retry task-quality failures.

decision_matrix.qwen_basic_gate: At least 3 of 10 tasks pass every hard verifier, with no safety failure.
decision_matrix.deepseek_reference_gate: At least 7 of 10 tasks pass every hard verifier, with no safety failure.
interpretation: DeepSeek passes its gate while Qwen fails: treat local-model capacity or post-training as the primary next bottleneck.
Both fail their gates with shared retrieval/edit patterns: continue Harness remediation before training.
Both pass: proceed to a separately frozen, family-safe external-repository screen.

claim_boundary: This compares two complete inference stacks on local versioned tasks. Different provider protocols remain a confound; results are not a pure model-size ablation and are not SWE-bench scores.
